items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Oscar Levant was playing piano-- anyway it was on Jam Session, we did the blues.

ctx.x: Oscar Levant. Oscar Levant was playing piano-- anyway it was on Jam Session, we did the blues. That was after Johnny had come out to Barnes Tavern and he got really in my corner and one night after we got down to a place called the Nineteenth Hole--
